servinfo.title: Warning for Dual Camera Brake Support System

item.ptxt: Failure to take the following precautions may cause a serious accident affected by malfunction of dual camera brake support system.
When replacing windshield, windshield wiper arm or windshield wiper blade, be sure to use genuine parts with specified part numbers.
Do not install aftermarket parts such as navigation unit on top of instrument panel.
Do not drop or otherwise expose stereo camera to large shock. The stereo camera that has received large shock should be replaced.
Do not modify suspension. Modification of the vehicle’s height or inclination may affect correct detection of a running vehicle ahead.
Use tires of the same size and brand. Do not mix tires of different wear.
When vehicle is hoisted and wheels are rotated with engine running, disable dual camera brake support system beforehand. If not, dual camera brake support could work unexpectedly.

When driving such a vehicle, disable dual camera brake support system by pushing the dual camera brake support OFF switch or ESP® OFF switch for a long time to turn on dual camera brake support OFF indicator light beforehand.
